Name: (CP) Sebastian Revised
Author: stanloona420
Description:
I had been putting off a Sebastian mod because, to me, he was already perfect... but maybe I was a little biased ok. I admit it.


I made two options, one leaning into the emo vibe, and one leaning out of it! 
The two options take some inspiration from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6475]xhotfish's less emo mod[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3104]vienix's more emo mod[/url] respectively, go check them out!! They're sooooo good!


Not much else to say about this mod, exept that the character sheet's hair does not match the "less emo" style because honestly I hate editing character sheets lol. The colors match, but the hair is not shortened. I'll get around to fixing it [i]eventuallyyyyy.[/i]

[list]
[*][size=3]Download whichever file you prefer[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file [/size]
